name: BSP_LobbySettings_CopyStoredOptions

name: BSP_LobbySettings_MenuRowForSlot
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall int(int slot), body 005d5500..005d55ac. Returns the multiplayer lobby menu row a LobbySettings slot occupies in the current effective game mode (004bca50), or -1 when the mode does not offer it: slot 1 answers 0 before the mode is read; modes 0..3 map 3,5,7,8,10,11,12,13 to rows 1..8; mode 4 maps 4,6,9,11,12,13; modes 5 and 6 map 11,12,13; mode 7 maps 6,8,11,12,13. 005e30d2 uses -1 as the publish-nil test and 005d6350 uses row 1 as a write target. docs/MISSION_LOBBY_SETTINGS.md.
